turns.text: Hello... I need to get to Mumbai today. There's been a death in the family, the funeral is tonight.
I'm very sorry for your loss. I'll do what I can. May I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Mr. Farouk. I see SK510 to Mumbai on Thursday at 07:45, Economy, booked six days ago. Is that the booking you want to change?
Yes. I need to go today, not Thursday. Any flight, please. The cheapest one.

Since it's now 10:00, the flight today is SK512 at 21:00 at 190 dollars. Because your booking is over 24 hours old, there's a 75 dollar change fee, and your fare was 210, so 190 is 20 dollars cheaper. I can't refund the difference, so the cost would be the 75 dollar fee.
Seventy-five... money is, it's tight right now. But I'll pay it. Is there nothing that, that can be waived?
I'm so sorry, I can't waive the fee under our policy. I can arrange a supervisor callback if you'd like to ask about it, but I can't promise any outcome.
No, there's no time. Please just book the 21:00.
Done. You're on SK512 today at 21:00 with the 75 dollar fee. Again, I'm sorry for your loss.
Take care, Mr. Farouk. To sum up, I moved you from SK510 on Thursday to SK512 today at 21:00 for a 75 dollar fee.
